rows.heading: Replacement & Cadre Balancing Norms
rows.quote_snippet: 10.1 Discipline-for-Discipline Matching: In critical operational disciplines (Drilling, Production, Reservoir, Geology, Geophysics, Electrical, Mechanical, and Instrumentation), no executive shall be relieved from an operational asset until a qualified replacement of matching discipline and comparable seniority has reported or been placed on the mobilization schedule. 10.2 Asset Head Concurrence: Asset Managers and Basin In-charges must certify that replacement arrangements are in place to prevent production disruption.
